scope: Official-document review, local reproductions, fixes, regression tests and browser verification of the offline CAN monitor.

primary_sources.used_for: Native ASCWriter header, metadata and 1-based ASC channels
Single-process native write and cross-process read-only operating boundary

findings.change: Read unmodified ASCWriter whitespace and recognized triggerblock/measurement metadata while preserving source bytes and physical lines.
Parser and direct API reject accepted-frame spans over 24 hours before minute expansion.
Repeatable --expected-channel selects actual 1-based ASC channels; UI displays active parameters.
Six decimal places for seconds, three for milliseconds, and integer timestamp_us source evidence.
User-provided unverified logs are no longer globally labeled as simulation.

findings.condition: Reproduced using deliberately modified temporary databases; no inconsistency was found in the original working demo database.
findings.change: Independent SQL reconciles every minute's metrics. Inconsistent same-fingerprint publications rebuild atomically; --force also supports explicit rebuilding.
Two-by-two metric layout and time/rule/duration columns before opaque identifiers.

assessment: Reproducible offline learning and interview demonstration; not evidence of independent authorship, physical vehicle behavior or CANoe execution.
remaining_boundaries: Fixed classic CAN standard-ID protocol; no arbitrary DBC or CAN FD support.
Single accepted-frame span at most 24 hours.
Native local DuckDB workflow imports first, then uses the read-only UI.
Database consistency checks do not authenticate source files or verify physical signals.
